info.title: ReLoop API
info.description: The core loop: explainable matching, the full donation lifecycle, rejection handling, escalation, a recycling fallback and the deadline sweeper (in-process every 15 minutes; POST /admin/sweep runs it now). Phase 3 adds an in-app notification feed (polled; no push or email), a public discovery map of verified organisations at approximate positions, and a chat between a donor and the organisation that accepted their donation (polled). Phase 4 adds a third handover path (a platform-arranged pickup the donor books and pays for), a donor wallet credited by confirmed recycling settlements, and a commission ledger for admins. **Stubs and simulations:** geocoding is a stub (coordinates are accepted as supplied); recycling settlements are **simulated** over **estimated** mass (per-category weights are placeholders), an admin confirms recycling on the recycler's behalf, and platform-arranged pickup is a **simulated** courier booking with a **simulated**, auto-succeeding checkout. No real money moves.

post.description: OAuth2 password flow. `username` is the account's email address.

Exchange a refresh token for a new access token. Stateless: refresh tokens are
not rotated or revocable (see README, Known limitations).

schema.title: Response List Needs Organisations Me Needs Get

post.description:
Unverified organisations may maintain needs; verification gates matching (Phase 2),
not list upkeep.

patch.description: Update quantity or urgency, or set is_active=false. Needs are never deleted.

get.description:
Open offers, highest queue priority first (priority donations and donations that
have been declined elsewhere rise), then oldest first. No address or coordinates.

schema.title: Response List Offers Organisations Me Offers Get

post.description:
MATCHED → ACCEPTED. Releases the precise pickup address to this organisation (the
release is recorded) for as long as it holds the donation.

Recorded with its reason code, never deleted. This organisation is never offered
the donation again; it is re-offered or escalated to its donor at once.

schema.title: Response List Accepted Donations Organisations Me Donations Get

post.description:
ACCEPTED → PICKUP_SCHEDULED, this organisation collecting. The time must be in the
future; the donor's pickup window is advisory. Not offered if the organisation does
not collect (pickup_capable false).
PICKUP_SCHEDULED or IN_TRANSIT → COMPLETED: reuse, an outcome.

schema.title: Response List My Donations Donations Get

post.description:
Send to recycling: the donor's own choice. Creates the donation and moves it to
WASTE_REDIRECTED in one step, with reason DONOR_CHOICE. It is never offered to an
organisation. With no active recycler it goes to the admin queue.

get.description:
Readable by the donor who owns it and by admins. Anyone else gets 404. An admin
read of the precise address is recorded.

patch.description: Only while the donation is editable (LISTED). Status cannot be set here.

get.description: Status events, every offer and its response, and any recycling (simulated).

The eligible organisations, best first, each score broken into its factors. A
preview: nothing is stored. Offering re-ranks and stores the slate it used.

post.description:
LISTED → MATCHED: offer to the top candidate, or to `organization_id` if it is in
the eligible slate. If the slate is empty the donation escalates instead
(status ESCALATED, escalation_cause NO_CANDIDATES).

Withdraw the donation (from LISTED, MATCHED or ESCALATED). It is kept, with status
CANCELLED, not deleted. An open offer is closed as RETRACTED.

ESCALATED → re-offer to the next candidate. Offered only while the slate is
non-empty.

As rematch, and flags the donation as priority. Priority orders acceptors' inboxes;
it does not change which organisations are eligible or how they are ranked.

ESCALATED → WASTE_REDIRECTED, routed to the nearest active recycler for the
category. If there is none, the donation goes to the admin queue (NEEDS_ADMIN).

WASTE_REDIRECTED → RECYCLING_IN_TRANSIT: the donor reports they dropped the
goods at the assigned recycler. There is no recycler login, so this report is the
only evidence of the handover, and is what makes an admin's confirm-recycled
available.

get.description:
WASTE_REDIRECTED only: a SIMULATED quote per active logistics provider for a
platform pickup to the assigned recycler, and the donor's current wallet balance.
A preview: nothing is stored. Booking re-quotes.

post.description:
WASTE_REDIRECTED → RECYCLING_IN_TRANSIT: a SIMULATED platform-arranged pickup to
the assigned recycler, paid for by the donor (wallet credit first, then a simulated
checkout for the rest). The time only has to be in the future.

ACCEPTED → ACCEPTED: the donor picks "organisation collects", without a time.
Unlocks the organisation's own schedule-pickup action; the donor's other two
handover choices disappear once this is recorded.
ACCEPTED → PICKUP_SCHEDULED, the donor delivering. The time must be in the future.
PICKUP_SCHEDULED → IN_TRANSIT: the donor has handed the goods over.

get.description:
ACCEPTED only: a SIMULATED quote per active logistics provider, and the donor's
current wallet balance. A preview: nothing is stored. Booking re-quotes.

post.description:
ACCEPTED → PICKUP_SCHEDULED: a SIMULATED platform-arranged pickup, paid for by
the donor (wallet credit first, then a simulated checkout for the rest). The time
only has to be in the future: the pickup window is advisory.

Validated server-side and re-encoded, which strips EXIF (including GPS) and other
metadata. All-or-nothing: if any file is rejected, none is stored.

schema.title: Response Upload Images Donations  Donation Id  Images Post

get.description:
The donor, admins, and an organisation while it has an open offer for the
donation or holds it.

schema.title: Response List Organisations Admin Organisations Get

get.description:
How many organisations are in each verification status, and how many await an
admin's decision (every organisation starts PENDING).

patch.description:
The only way an organisation's verification status changes. Records which admin
changed it and when.

get.description: Without addresses. The precise address is in the detail, where each read is recorded.

schema.title: Response List Donations Admin Donations Get

get.description:
Donations that could not be routed (NEEDS_ADMIN), longest-waiting first, with the
transition that put each one here and what can be done about it.

schema.title: Response Unroutable Queue Admin Queue Get

get.description:
Every donation waiting on an admin: the states with an admin action out of them
(lifecycle.states_awaiting(ADMIN): the unroutable queue, and recycling to confirm),
longest-waiting first, with the transition that put each one there and what can be
done about it.

schema.title: Response Awaiting Admin Admin Awaiting Get

get.description: Full detail, including the precise address. This read is recorded.

post.description:
NEEDS_ADMIN → back into matching: re-offered at once, or escalated to the donor if
the decline threshold is still reached. Offered only while the slate is non-empty.
NEEDS_ADMIN → WASTE_REDIRECTED. Offered only if a recycler can take it.
NEEDS_ADMIN → CANCELLED.

RECYCLING_IN_TRANSIT → RECYCLED, once the donor's own handover to the recycler
is recorded (drop-off or a platform pickup) — never straight from
WASTE_REDIRECTED; there is no recycler login to confirm receipt any other way.
SIMULATED: the admin confirms on the recycler's behalf, and a simulated settlement
over estimated mass is recorded (see the donation's timeline). No money moves.

Apply every due deadline now: expired offers, donations never offered, silent
donors and stalled handovers. Safe to run repeatedly. Also: python -m app.cli sweep.

schema.title: Response List Recyclers Admin Recyclers Get

get.description:
The platform's earnings ledger: logistics fees and recycling fees. A cancelled,
undelivered booking's commission is reversed by a second, negated row, so `total`
is always net. SIMULATED: no money actually moves.

Newest first: status events on donations you are party to, chat messages from the
other party in threads you can read, and (admins) organisation registrations. In-app
only: derived on each request, with no push or email and no server-side read state
(see README). Poll it, and track read items by `key`.

The chat threads on a donation that you can read, newest acceptance first, each
with its messages. A thread is one accepted offer: the donor reads every thread on
their donation; the organisation reads its own while its acceptance is the latest.
Both can write from acceptance onward, including after completion; a thread closes
(closed_reason) only when the organisation stops holding the donation without
completing it. Admins have no access to chats. Poll it: there is no push.

post.description:
Append a message (messages are never edited or deleted). 409 if the thread is
closed. Returns the whole thread.

You have been shown the thread up to `up_to_message_id`: messages from the other
party up to it stop counting as unread (`unread` here, and `chat.unread` on the
donation). Read state is kept per user on the server; it never moves backward.
Works on closed threads too.

get.description:
Public, no login. Verified organisations with their active needs, at positions
rounded to about a kilometre. No address, phone, contact person or registration ID.

The donor's wallet: an append-only ledger. The balance is SUM(amount), never
stored. Credited by confirmed recycling settlements; spent, in full or in part, on
a platform-arranged pickup; refunded if that pickup is cancelled before delivery.
No withdrawals.

The donor's totals over their finished donations: reused and recycled, separately.
Estimates, labelled as such.

The organisation's reuse totals: donations it accepted and that were completed.
Recycling is not credited to an organisation. Estimates, labelled as such.

distance_km.title: Distance Km
distance_km.description: Approximate: rounded to the nearest 0.5 km.

awaiting_donor_handover_choice.title: Awaiting Donor Handover Choice
awaiting_donor_handover_choice.description: True only while ACCEPTED, this organisation collects, nothing is scheduled, and the donor hasn't yet chosen this path (so there is no schedule action to show, rather than one the donor hasn't pressed).

chat.description: This organisation's chat with the donor; null when it can no longer read the thread.

AcceptedDonationOut.title: AcceptedDonationOut
AcceptedDonationOut.description:
A donation this organisation accepted. The precise address is present only while
the organisation holds it (ACCEPTED, PICKUP_SCHEDULED, IN_TRANSIT).

AcceptorRegister.title: AcceptorRegister
AcceptorRegister.description:
Creates the acceptor's login and its organisation profile together.
The organisation starts PENDING; only an admin can verify it.

AccessToken.title: AccessToken
AccessToken.description:
Refreshing issues a new access token only. The refresh token is not extended, so a
session ends when the refresh token expires, however active it has been.

Actor.title: Actor
Actor.description:
Who performs a lifecycle action. SYSTEM covers both in-request automation
(re-offers, escalation) and the sweeper.

AdminDonationDetailOut.title: AdminDonationDetailOut
AdminDonationDetailOut.description: Includes the precise address; every read is recorded in address_access_events.

wallet_amount.title: Wallet Amount
wallet_amount.description: How much of the wallet balance to apply; capped at the cost.

BookingOut.title: BookingOut
BookingOut.description:
SIMULATED: no real courier, no real payment gateway. Status is derived from
which of booked_at/picked_up_at/delivered_at/cancelled_at are set.

BookingStatus.title: BookingStatus
BookingStatus.description:
A platform-arranged pickup's own progress. Derived from Booking's nullable
write-once timestamps (app.models.logistics), never stored as a column.

Category.title: Category
Category.description: MVP categories. Food is deliberately out of scope (no cold-chain handling).

ChatClosure.title: ChatClosure
ChatClosure.description: Why a donor-organisation chat thread no longer takes messages (it stays readable).

sender.description: DONOR or ACCEPTOR: which side of the thread wrote it.

sender_name.title: Sender Name
sender_name.description: The organisation's name for its messages. Null for the donor's: the donor's name is not disclosed to the organisation.

mine.title: Mine
mine.description: Written by the user reading the thread.

notification_key.title: Notification Key
notification_key.description: The key of the notification this message produced for the reader (messages from the other party only), so a client can mark it read when the thread is shown.

up_to_message_id.title: Up To Message Id
up_to_message_id.description: The newest message the reader has been shown, in this thread.

threads.title: Threads
threads.description: Threads the viewer can read (more than one after an admin requeue).

unread.title: Unread
unread.description: Unread messages from the other party, across those threads.

can_write.title: Can Write
can_write.description: Whether one of them still takes messages.

ChatSummaryOut.title: ChatSummaryOut
ChatSummaryOut.description:
On a donation, for its donor or the organisation that accepted it: present only
when the viewer can read at least one chat thread on it.

id.title: Id
id.description: The thread: the accepted offer's id. Post to /chats/{id}/messages.

closed_reason.description: Why the thread no longer takes messages, when can_write is false.

unread.title: Unread
unread.description: Messages from the other party the reader has not marked read.

source_id.title: Source Id
source_id.description: A Booking id (LOGISTICS) or a Recycling id (RECYCLING).

CommissionEntryOut.title: CommissionEntryOut
CommissionEntryOut.description:
One ledger row. A cancelled, undelivered booking's commission is reversed by a
second row with the negated amount (never edited or deleted).

CommissionSource.title: CommissionSource
CommissionSource.description:
What earned a commission ledger entry. A cancelled booking's commission is
reversed by a second, negative entry (never edited or deleted).

raw.title: Raw
raw.description: The underlying fact: km (PROXIMITY), items needed (NEED_MATCH), urgency (URGENCY), remaining items (CAPACITY_HEADROOM), observed rate or null if no history (ACCEPTANCE_RATE).

contribution.title: Contribution
contribution.description: weight x value; the contributions sum to the score.

ComponentOut.title: ComponentOut
ComponentOut.description:
One factor of a score. Structured, not a sentence, so a client can render or
translate it: e.g. PROXIMITY, raw 2.1 (km), value 0.86, weight 0.3, contribution 0.258.

position_error_km.title: Position Error Km
position_error_km.description: The furthest a shown position can be from the organisation's real one.

DonationAction.title: DonationAction
DonationAction.description:
Things that can happen to a donation. The lifecycle table maps
(state, action) -> next state, and declares who may perform each.

condition.description: Null for a donation sent straight to recycling.

chat.description: The donor's chat with the accepting organisation; null until there is a thread, and for admins.

DonationStatus.title: DonationStatus
DonationStatus.description:
Donation lifecycle states. Which state may follow which is defined only in
`app.domain.lifecycle`.

condition.description: Null for a donation sent straight to recycling.

DonationSummaryOut.title: DonationSummaryOut
DonationSummaryOut.description: A donation without its precise address or coordinates (admin lists and queue).

DonationUpdate.title: DonationUpdate
DonationUpdate.description:
Any subset of the donor-editable fields. Status is not here: it changes only
through lifecycle actions such as POST /donations/{id}/cancel.

EscalationCause.title: EscalationCause
EscalationCause.description: Why the system escalated a donation to its donor.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Admin-recorded reason. Shown to admins only.

FilterReason.title: FilterReason
FilterReason.description: Why an organisation was left out of a slate (hard filters, applied before scoring).

HandoverMode.title: HandoverMode
HandoverMode.description: Decides who sets the handover time, not who performs the transitions.

HandoverOptionOut.title: HandoverOptionOut
HandoverOptionOut.description:
One handover path for an accepted donation, as the donor sees it. Informational
when `you_do_it` is false: the organisation performs it, so there is no button.

handover.description: Set once a pickup or drop-off is scheduled.

HolderOut.title: HolderOut
HolderOut.description:
The organisation holding the donation (lifecycle.HELD_STATES), shown to its donor
with the organisation's address and contact for the handover. Present only while
held; once the donation leaves those states the donor no longer sees them.

carbon_avoided_kg.title: Carbon Avoided Kg
carbon_avoided_kg.description: Reuse only; recycling is never credited with carbon.

ImpactTotalsOut.title: ImpactTotalsOut
ImpactTotalsOut.description:
Totals over finished donations. Every figure is an ESTIMATE: mass is modelled from
item counts, and carbon from a per-item factor. Reuse and recycling are separate.
`placeholders` is true while the per-item factors are unsourced.

NeedUpdate.title: NeedUpdate
NeedUpdate.description:
A need's category is fixed; to need something else, add a new need. Needs are
never deleted: set is_active to false instead.

NotificationKind.title: NotificationKind
NotificationKind.description: What an item in the in-app notification feed is about.

key.title: Key
key.description: Unique and stable; use it to remember which items have been read.

verification_status.description: ORGANISATION_REGISTERED only: the organisation's status now.

NotificationOut.title: NotificationOut
NotificationOut.description:
One feed item. Which fields are set depends on `kind`:

- DONATION_EVENT: the donation fields and the transition (action, actor, states, cause);
  organization_name is the organisation of the offer the event concerns, if any.
- ORGANISATION_REGISTERED (admins): organization_id, organization_name and the
  organisation's current verification_status.
- CHAT_MESSAGE: the donation fields, and organization_name of the thread. Never the
  message text.

Admin reasons, acceptors' rejection notes and chat text are never included.

organization_id.title: Organization Id
organization_id.description: Any organisation in the eligible slate. Omit for the top candidate.

rank.title: Rank
rank.description: The organisation's rank in the slate the offer was made from.

response.description: null while the offer is open.

note.title: Note
note.description: The acceptor's note on a rejection. Shown to admins only.

distance_km.title: Distance Km
distance_km.description: Approximate: rounded to the nearest 0.5 km.

OfferResponse.title: OfferResponse
OfferResponse.description: The single, write-once response to an offer (a Match row).

OfferSource.title: OfferSource
OfferSource.description: Whether an offer was the donor's choice or made by the system (re-offers).

awaiting_verification.title: Awaiting Verification
awaiting_verification.description: Organisations an admin has yet to verify or reject.

OrganizationUpdate.title: OrganizationUpdate
OrganizationUpdate.description:
Operational fields only. name and registration_id cannot change after
registration (unknown fields are rejected), so a verified organisation cannot
become a different one.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: What the simulated gateway charged (cost minus wallet_applied).

PaymentStatus.title: PaymentStatus
PaymentStatus.description: Derived from Payment.refunded_at, never stored as a column.

PickupQuoteOut.title: PickupQuoteOut
PickupQuoteOut.description: A preview: nothing is stored. Booking re-quotes and stores what it quoted.

QueueItemOut.title: QueueItemOut
QueueItemOut.description: A donation waiting on an admin, with the transition that put it there.

slate.title: Slate
slate.description: The eligible organisations the decision was made against, best first.

RankingTrigger.title: RankingTrigger
RankingTrigger.description: What caused a stored ranking run.

RecycleDonationCreate.title: RecycleDonationCreate
RecycleDonationCreate.description:
Send to recycling: the donor's own choice, not a fallback. The item is never
offered to an organisation. Condition is optional: the donor may not know it. No
note or priority, since neither has a meaning without matching.

handover.description: The donor's record of delivery to this recycler.

settlement.description: Set once the recycling is confirmed.

weights_are_placeholders.title: Weights Are Placeholders
weights_are_placeholders.description: The per-category weights are placeholders pending a cited source.

RecyclingOut.title: RecyclingOut
RecyclingOut.description:
SIMULATED settlement over ESTIMATED mass. No money moves; Phase 4 adds wallets.

The collector's address and coordinates are a business address, not donor-sensitive
information, so they are shown plainly (unlike an organisation's address, which is
released only on acceptance). `handover` is the donor's own record of moving the
goods there (drop-off or a platform pickup) — null until they do, which is what
admin confirm-recycled is waiting on. Nobody confirms the recycler actually
received the goods: there is no recycler login, so the donor's record of delivery
is the only evidence.

ScoreFactor.title: ScoreFactor
ScoreFactor.description: Ranking factors. Donor rating is deliberately absent until reviews exist.

radius_km.title: Radius Km
radius_km.description: Search radius; widens with each decline (capped).

filtered_out.title: Filtered Out
filtered_out.description: Organisations accepting this category that the hard filters removed, by reason.

SlateOut.title: SlateOut
SlateOut.description:
The donation's eligible organisations, best first. A preview: nothing is stored
until an offer is made, which re-ranks and stores the slate it was made against.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.description: Platform-arranged pickup bookings (SIMULATED). Usually at most one; more than one only if an earlier booking was cancelled and the donation was accepted again.

WalletOut.title: WalletOut
WalletOut.description: The balance is derived (SUM of the ledger), never stored. No withdrawals.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Signed: positive credits the donor, negative debits them.

WalletTxnType.title: WalletTxnType
WalletTxnType.description: One row per ledger entry; the balance is SUM(amount), never stored.
